editor.title: Formula editor
editor.subtitle: {{field}} · table {{table}}
editor.label: Formula
editor.placeholder: Type [ for fields and tables, or a function name

ai.label: Describe the formula
ai.placeholder: e.g. Profit: amount minus cost, 0 when the order is not done
ai.waitingLater: Checking the formula and fixing it if needed…
ai.waitingHint: AI can take up to 90 seconds to answer.

errors.AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: The AI could not write a valid formula in 3 tries. Describe it differently or name the fields to use.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: The AI took longer than 90 seconds. Try again, or describe a smaller formula.
errors.AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your organization has used up today's AI quota.

field.missing: Write the formula of this field.
field.mobileTitle: Edit on a screen of 768 px or more
field.mobileBody: On a phone you can only read the formula and its result. Open this base on a computer or tablet to edit it.
field.copyFailed: The formula could not be copied.

catalogue.phase2Doc: Not available yet: a formula using this function cannot be saved.
catalogue.fieldDoc: The value of this field in the same record.
catalogue.linkDoc: A link: [Link].[Field] gives the values of the linked records as a list.
catalogue.tableDoc: All records of the table. [Table].[Field] gives a whole column as a list; [Table].FILTER(…) keeps the records matching a condition.
catalogue.currentValueDoc: Inside FILTER, MAP, COUNTIF, SUMIF or SORTBY: the record (over a table) or the value (over a list) being tested. CurrentValue.[Field] reads a field of that record.
catalogue.letDoc: A variable defined earlier in LET.
catalogue.volatile: Its value changes over time: a formula using it is computed each time it is read, not stored.

guide.title: Writing formulas
guide.links: Through a link: [Link].[Field] gives the values of the linked records.
guide.text: Text in double quotes: "Done". Numbers use a dot: 0.1.

errors.UNKNOWN_FIELD_named: There is no field “{{name}}” here (or you cannot see it).
errors.WRONG_ARGUMENT_COUNT: {{function}} takes {{min, number}} to {{max, number}} arguments, not {{actual, number}}.
errors.WRONG_ARGUMENT_COUNT_open: {{function}} takes at least {{min, number}} arguments, not {{actual, number}}.
errors.TYPE_MISMATCH_text: The results must all have the same type. Wrap this one in TEXT() to turn it into text.

preview.empty: Write a formula to see its result.
preview.timeout: The preview took too long. Simplify the formula or try again.
preview.failed: The preview could not be computed.
preview.blankHint: This record gives an empty cell: its data is empty, or the formula fails on it (division by 0…). The formula can still be saved; IFERROR(…, 0) shows a value instead.

perf.virtual: This formula may be slow on large tables: it queries another table without going through a link field and is computed each time it is read. Filter through a link field if you can.
perf.wrapped: This formula may be slow on large tables: it queries another table without going through a link field, and its condition applies a function to CurrentValue.[…]. Compare CurrentValue.[field] directly with a value or a field instead.

paramKinds.dates: dates, or a list of dates.
paramKinds.range: a table or a list to go through.
paramKinds.condition: true or false for each record or value; CurrentValue is the one being tested.
paramKinds.mapping: the value computed for each element; CurrentValue is the element.

result.label: Result
result.unknown: Known once the formula is valid.

mode.label: Computation
mode.stored: Stored, computed again when its data changes.
mode.virtual: Computed each time it is read (not stored).
mode.virtualVolatile: Computed each time it is read (not stored), because {{function}}() changes over time.
mode.virtualDependency: Computed each time it is read (not stored), because it uses “{{field}}”, which is computed on read.

style.timeZone: Dates follow the organization time zone ({{zone}}).
style.none: This result type has no format.

discard.title: Discard the changes to this formula?
